description:
The loop itself (per port-map §2). Runs inside a Task under
OctoPi.Agent.LoopSupervisor, linked to the Session GenServer (die
together).

Scope for this ticket:
- Emit agent_start / agent_end events.
- Per-turn: turn_start → LLM stream → message_start/update/end →
  sequential tool dispatch → tool_execution_* events → turn_end.
- Loop exit conditions: stop_reason in [:error, :aborted] OR no
  tool calls + empty queues.
- **Sequential tool dispatch only** for this ticket. Parallel in z1d.4.
- No steering / follow-up drainage yet (stubbed empty queues).
- No hooks yet (stubbed).

TDD fixtures use a fake transport that yields canned Anthropic-style
events. Mirrors anthropic/producer_test.exs patterns.

Tests to land:
- agent_start/agent_end fire with correct messages
- turn_start/end wraps the LLM stream
- assistant message appended to state.messages
- tool_use stop_reason triggers tool dispatch
- tool results appended in source order
- stop with reason :stop exits the loop cleanly
- error event from LLM exits and appends synthetic error message

Depends on z1d.2.
title: Core loop: inner + outer + LLM stream + sequential tool dispatch
